messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired for service 'hosted-inference' — High 5xx rate (10m avg 4.8%). Incident PD-8921. Escalation policy: SRE-oncall -> SRE-secondary -> Eng-manager. Link: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/PD-8921
Devon (oncall): ACKed — taking this. will triage logs/metrics, starting with eu-west-1.
Devon (oncall): Seeing spike concentrated in eu-west-1: nginx/gRPC 502s and runtime 5xx. Dashboards show CPU steady but backend timeouts rising. Investigating autoscaler and runtime errors.
Lucy (SRE): trying to reach secondary (Ashok) — PD shows no ACK. IncidentBot will attempt SMS escalation in 2m.
IncidentBot: Escalation step: notified secondary Ashok via push + SMS — no ACK after 2m — next step: manager escalation in 4m.
Ashok: Sorry all, in transit (no reliable cell). I can join remote in ~8–10m. If you need immediate kernel rollback, I can authorize remotely.
Devon (oncall): roger. holding. kicking mitigations: temporarily increase inference replicas to absorb queue. Running: `kubectl scale deploy/inference -n prod --replicas=10`
Maria H: Opening bridge and notifying CS. Bridge: https://meet.company/bridge/PD-8921 — adding short comms: "We’re investigating elevated error rates in EU; mitigation underway."
Devon (oncall): Started scale; logs show repeated runtime errors: ```2026-03-15T02:10:12Z runtime ERROR shard=7 cache miss -> backend timeout
2026-03-15T02:10:14Z runtime ERROR kernel:q8 compile fail -> fallback 502```
Ashok: ETA ~7m, but quick idea: recent rollout included q8 quantized kernel for speed. If compilers degrade in eu nodes we should revert to q4.
IncidentBot: Manager escalation triggered: Kate - Eng Manager notified (push/email). Secondary timed out.
Kate - Eng Manager: on pager. Devon — summary? customer impact? do we need a P1 bridge and external comms?
Devon (oncall): Current impact: ~8% of generation requests from EU returning 5xx over last 10m. Errors concentrated on long-context requests (>=2048 tokens). Scaling reduced queue pressure: error rate down 4.8% -> 2.1% over 3m, but still present. Recommend rollback of q8 variant in eu as Ashok suggested.
Maria H: Drafting public status: "We are experiencing elevated error rates for inference requests in EU. Mitigation in progress. No data loss. Expected recovery within 30 minutes." Need sign-off to send via status page and CS channels.
Kate - Eng Manager: send the status page update. Also notify top 10 paying EU customers via CS. Keep incident priority P1 until error rate <0.5%.
Ashok: On bridge now. Confirmed kernel miscompile on recent q8 rollouts for eu nodes. Running rollback command: `/deploy rollback model-hosted-v2 --variant q4 --region eu-west-1`
Devon (oncall): Rolling back variant on eu nodes now. Will monitor. ETA ~5m for rollout to finish and healthchecks.
IncidentBot: Automated healthcheck: 2m after rollback error rate trending down to 0.9% (10m avg). Pager status: secondary acknowledged.
Lucy (SRE): Great. Keeping monitoring windows open for 20m. If stable at <0.2% we can close PD incident.
Kate - Eng Manager: Thanks everyone. Post-incident: action items — 1) Add travel-safe fallback contact for secondaries in PD policy, 2) improve IncidentBot SMS fallback and escalate sooner if secondary is DND, 3) add a canary check for kernel q8 on eu before full rollout. I'll assign follow-ups in JIRA.
Maria H: Noted — sending status out now and pinging CS for targeted customer outreach.
Devon (oncall): closing bridge in 10m once metrics steady. Leaving PD incident open for postmortem.
_meta: Generated Slack thread for incident coordination: pager/incidentbot escalation, delayed secondary ack and manager escalation. No title field per agents.md rules.
